quotes.text: ¿CUÁL ES LA RELACIÓN DE PARENTESCO CON EL JEFE(A) DEL HOGAR?
Si HOGAR es la persona o grupo de personas que se alimentan de una misma olla y atienden en común otras necesidades básicas.
(203-B) RELACIÓN DE PARENTESCO CON EL JEFE(A) DEL NÚCLEO FAMILIAR

assessments.reasoning: member_to_member_relationships is false because relationship is collected only relative to the head of the household (P203) and the head of the nuclear family (P203-B), without pointer variables or a member-to-member grid. extended_ties is true because Q203 explicitly lists extended family members and non-kin such as grandchildren, siblings, and non-relatives. multiple_household_criteria is true because Question 10 defines household separation criteria based on eating from the same pot and sharing basic needs. sub_units is true because Questions 203-A and 203-B explicitly identify family nuclei within the household. caregiving_relationships is false because no questions or variables exist to identify who provides care for whom inside or across households.
